recommendedForChildren.title: recommended for children
recommendedForChildren.description: Indicates if the house is suitable for children (0-12 years). Only available for rent operation.

petsAllowed.title: pets allowed
petsAllowed.description: Tells if pets are allowed in the property. Only available for rent operation

petsAllowedForRooms.title: pets allowed
petsAllowedForRooms.description: Tells if pets are allowed in the property.

areaBuildable.title: buildable area
areaBuildable.description: Land buildable area. Not allowed for type 'countrynonbuildable'

housingAreaConstructed.title: constructed area
housingAreaConstructed.description: Built square meters. It must be greater than 'areaUsable'

areaUsable.title: functional area
areaUsable.description: areUsable must be always lower than areaConstructed

auxiliaryEntrance.title: auxiliary entrance
auxiliaryEntrance.description: This option is only available if type = retail.</br>This is a private field. Bear in mind that this is not going to be shown in idealista portal, it will be shown in the private website, if the client have one.

bathroomAdapted.title: adapted bathroom
bathroomAdapted.description: Availability of adapted bathroom for disabled people

housingBathroomNumber.title: bathrooms number
housingBathroomNumber.description: Bathroom number can only be 0 if conservation = 'toRestore', otherwise it must be > 0

bridgeCrane.title: Bridge crane
bridgeCrane.description: This option is only available if type = industrial.</br>This is a private field. Bear in mind that this is not going to be shown in idealista portal, it will be shown in the private website, if the client have one.

classificationAgricultural.title: agricultural classified
classificationAgricultural.description: Only allowed in France for land typology with type=countrynonbuildable.

classificationIsland.title: island classified
classificationIsland.description: Only allowed in France for land typology with type=countrynonbuildable.

classificationLeisure.title: leisure classified
classificationLeisure.description: Only allowed in France for land typology with type=countrynonbuildable.

conservation.title: conservation status
conservation.description: </br> * new_development_in_construction and new_development_finished values are only available for Italy and France.  </br> * fullyReformed only available for Italy and it only be shown on casa.it

duplex.title: duplex
duplex.description: Flat on two floors connected by an indoor staircase

energyCertificateLaw.title: energy certification law
energyCertificateLaw.description: Only for Italy. Indicates the legislation that applies to the energy rating, DL-192(2005) or LEGGE-90(2013) For dl-192_2005 the values accepted are: A+, A, B, C, D, E, F, G. For legge-90_2013 the values accepted are: A4, A3, A2, A1, B, C, D, E, F, G

energyCertificatePerformance.title: energy certification performance
energyCertificatePerformance.description: Note: A valid "energyCertificateRating" value other than "uknown", "exempt" or "in_process" is required to send this value.

energyCertificateRating.title: energy certification rating
energyCertificateRating.description: </br> * Allowed values for Spain: A,B,C,D,E,F,G,exempt. Values in_process,unknown will be set to G for default. </br> * Allowed values for Italy: A+,A4,A3,A2,A1,A,B,C,D,E,F,G,exempt,in_process,unknown. </br> * Allowed values for Portugal: A+,A,B,B-,C,D,E,F,G,exempt,in_process,unknown. </br> * Allowed values for France: A,B,C,D,E,F,G,exempt,in_process,unknown.

energyCertificateType.title: energy certification type
energyCertificateType.description: Only available for new development properties. project: certification in project phase; completed: certification if the property is finished

energyCertificateEmissionsRating.title: energy certification emissions rating
energyCertificateEmissionsRating.description: Only available for Spain and France. </br>Note: </br> *A valid "energyCertificateRating" value other than "uknown", "exempt" or "in_process" is required to send this value.

energyCertificateEmissionsValue.title: energy certification emissions value
energyCertificateEmissionsValue.description: only available for Spain. Only allowed if energyCertificateEmissionsRating is present. Note: A valid "energyCertificateRating" value other than "uknown", "exempt" or "in_process" is required to send this value.

floorsBuilding.title: building floors
floorsBuilding.description: Total number of floors that the building has

isInTopFloor.title: floor in top
isInTopFloor.description: Indicates if the property is on the last floor

floorLevel.title: floor level andar de moradia floor
floorLevel.description: Specific and required field for 'andar de moradia' property type, indicates if the property is the one on the higher floor or the one in the lower floor

floorsProperty.title: property floors number
floorsProperty.description: Number of floors that belong to the property. It must be lower than floorsBuilding

floorsPropertyCommercial.title: property floors number
floorsPropertyCommercial.description: Number of floors that belong to the property

handicappedAdaptedAccess.title: handicapped adapted access availability
handicappedAdaptedAccess.description: Access adapted to people with reduced mobility

handicappedAdaptedUse.title: handicapped adapted use availability
handicappedAdaptedUse.description: Property adapted to people with reduced mobility

commercialLoadingDock.title: loading dock
commercialLoadingDock.description: This option is only available if type = industrial.</br>This is a private field. Bear in mind that this is not going to be shown in idealista portal, it will be shown in the private website, if the client have one.

nearestLocationKm.title: nearest location in km
nearestLocationKm.description: Only allowed if location is 'outside_town', this field indicates the distance in kilometers to the nearest town

parkingPrice.title: parking price
parkingPrice.description: Mandatory field if parking is available ('parkingAvailable' = true) and it is not included in total price ('parkingIncludedInPrice' = false)

parkingType.title: parking types
parkingType.description: This feature only applies for Portugal and Italy garages. 'depot' if is a box garage. 'parking_space' if is a regular garage

parkingSpacesNumber.title: parking spaces number
parkingSpacesNumber.description: Parking spaces number included on the price

housingRooms.title: rooms number
housingRooms.description: Room number can only be 0 if conservation = 'toRestore', otherwise it must be > 0

flatRooms.title: flat rooms number
flatRooms.description: Room number can only be 0 if conservation = 'toRestore' or studio = true, otherwise it must be > 0

office.title: office
office.description: This is a private field. Bear in mind that this is not going to be shown in idealista portal, it will be shown in the private website, if the client have one.

windowsLocation.title: windows location
windowsLocation.description: Internal / external flat based on windows view. Only available (and mandatory) for Spain.

windowsLocationByRoom.title: windows location for Room
windowsLocationByRoom.description: Internal / external flat based on windows view. Only available for Spain.

accessType.title: access type
accessType.description: This field is mandatory when the field roadAccess is true and not allowed if roadAccess is false

priceCommunity.title: price community
priceCommunity.description: Monthly community fees. It can only be defined for sale operation in Spain and Portugal. In Italy, it can be defined for both rent and sale operations

depositMonths.title: deposit months
depositMonths.description: </br> * It can only be defined for rent operation. </br> *In Spain and France deposit months must be between 1 mont to 6 mont for all typologies except Garage and Land that can be from 0 (no deposit) to 6 months

equipment.title: equipment
equipment.description: Only available for rent operation. Equipped kitchen with appliances and furnished, only equipped kitchen with appliances or neither of both

tenantNumber.title: tenant number
tenantNumber.description: Max number of flat mates allowed, including the tenant itself

tenantNumberForHousing.title: tenant number
tenantNumberForHousing.description: Max number of flat mates allowed, including the tenant itself. Only available for rent operation

smokingAllowed.title: smoking allowed
smokingAllowed.description: Tells if smoking is allowed in the property

couplesAllowed.title: couples allowed
couplesAllowed.description: Tells if couples are allowed in the property

minTenantAge.title: min tenant age
minTenantAge.description: Age of the youngest tenant. This field is mandatory if occupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if occupiedNow = false

maxTenantAge.title: min tenant age
maxTenantAge.description: Age of the oldest tenant. This field is mandatory if occupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if occupiedNow = false

minimalStay.title: Minimal stay
minimalStay.description: Minimal stay in months for the new tenant

windowView.title: window view types
windowView.description: This fill is mandatory for Spain, and not allowed for Italy and Portugal

ownerLiving.title: owner living
ownerLiving.description: Tells if the owner of the property lives there. This field is mandatory if occupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if occupiedNow = false

availableFrom.title: available from date
availableFrom.description: Date when the room will be available. The format must be 'yyyy-mm' (year-month) and the range of values goes from the current month to the following 5 months

tenantGender.title: tenant gender
tenantGender.description: Gender of the tenants that currently lives in the property. This field is mandatory if occupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if occupiedNow = false

furnished.title: furnished
furnished.description: Indicates if the room is furnished

lgtbFriendly.title: LGTB friendly
lgtbFriendly.description: Indicates if the flat mates are comfortable sharing the property with a LGTB person

occupiedNow.title: occupied now
occupiedNow.description: Indicates if the property is currently occupied

tenantWorkers.title: tenants workers
tenantWorkers.description: It can only be sent if 'occupiedNow' is true. Indicates if there are workers in the property

tenantStudents.title: tenants students
tenantStudents.description: It can only be sent if 'occupiedNow' is true. Indicates if there are students in the property

minAge.title: min age
minAge.description: Minimum age limit for the new tenant. It must be sent together with maxAge

maxAge.title: max age
maxAge.description: Maximum age limit for the new tenant. It must be sent together with minAge

exteriorAccessibility.title: exterior accessibility
exteriorAccessibility.description: Access of the property is adapted for people with reduced mobility

interiorAccessibility.title: exterior accessibility
interiorAccessibility.description: Property is adapted for people with reduced mobility

priceReferenceIndex.title: Price Reference Index
priceReferenceIndex.description: The reference index of rental prices is a compulsory public guidance figure from the Housing Agency of Catalonia (Spain) for the vast majority of its municipalities, indicating the price analyzed according to the area and its specific characteristics

isAuction.title: auction property
isAuction.description: Only allowed for Italy. Only allowed for sale operation. Indicates if the property is an auction

minAuctionBidIncrement.title: auction minimal bid increment
minAuctionBidIncrement.description: Only allowed if isAuction is true. Indicates the minimal bid increment for an auction

auctionDeposit.title: auction deposit
auctionDeposit.description: Only allowed if isAuction is true. Indicates the deposit percentage

auctionDate.title: auction date
auctionDate.description: Mandatory if isAuction is true. Indicates the date when the auction takes place. The format must be 'yyyy-mm-dd'

auctionTribunal.title: auction tribunal
auctionTribunal.description: Only allowed if isAuction is true. Indicates the tribunal where the auction takes place

currentOccupation.title: current occupation
currentOccupation.description:
In Spain, Portugal and France this field is only allowed for flat, house and country house properties. It's also only allowed for sale operation. Mandatory for France. It indicates the occupation state of the property.
Possible values:
-*Spain*: "free","bare_ownership", "tenanted", "illegally_occupied".
-*Italy*: "not_free", "free","bare_ownership", "tenanted".
-*Portugal*: "free", "tenanted".
-*France*: "free", "tenanted", "life_estate".

gardenType.title: garden type
gardenType.description: only available for Italy. Only allowed if garden is true

hiddenPrice.title: hidden price
hiddenPrice.description: only available for Italy. Trattativa riservata. Price must be sent. In idealista the property will not be shown, only available to edit in tools area. It will be sent to Casa.it only

parkingSpaceCapacity.title: parking space capacity
parkingSpaceCapacity.description: only available for Italy. Only allowed if parkingAvailable is true. Indicates the size of the parking space

parkingSpaceArea.title: parking space area
parkingSpaceArea.description: only available for Italy. Only allowed if parkingAvailable is true. Indicates the area of the parking space

outdoorParkingSpaceAvailable.title: outdoor parking space available
outdoorParkingSpaceAvailable.description: only available for Italy. Indicates if the property has an outdoor parking space

outdoorParkingSpaceType.title: parking space capacity
outdoorParkingSpaceType.description: only available for Italy. Only allowed if outdoorParkingSpaceAvailable is true. Indicates the type of the outdoor parking space

outdoorParkingSpaceNumber.title: parking space area
outdoorParkingSpaceNumber.description: only available for Italy. Only allowed if outdoorParkingSpaceAvailable is true. Indicates the number of outdoor parking spaces

residential.title: residential
residential.description: Indicates if the property is for residential rental. Only for rent operation. Only one of the following values can be true: seasonalRental, residential or shortTerm

seasonalRental.title: seasonal rental
seasonalRental.description: Indicates if the property is for seasonal rental. Only for rent operation. Only one of the following values can be true: seasonalRental, residential or shortTerm

shortTerm.title: short term
shortTerm.description: Only available for Italy and Portugal. Indicates if the property is for short term rental. Only for rent operation. Only one of the following values can be true: seasonalRental, residential or shortTerm.

shortTermLicense.title: short term license
shortTermLicense.description: Only available if shortTerm = true. Mandatory and only for Italy. License for the short term property

shortTermLicenseNational.title: short term license national
shortTermLicenseNational.description: Only available if shortTerm = true. Mandatory and only for Italy. National license for the short term property

lowSeasonPrice.title: low season price
lowSeasonPrice.description: Only available if shortTerm = true. Mandatory for Italy. Week price during the low season. Note that this field will only be shown if the property is also published in casa.it

highSeasonPrice.title: high season price
highSeasonPrice.description: Only available if shortTerm = true. Mandatory for Italy. Week price during the high season. Note that this field will only be shown if the property is also published in casa.it

thirdPartiesRented.title: third parties rented
thirdPartiesRented.description: Indicates if the property is rented to third parties

rentedYieldPercentage.title: rented yield percentage
rentedYieldPercentage.description: Only available if thirdPartiesRented is true. Yield percentage when the property is rented to third parties

isATransfer.title: transfer commercial
isATransfer.description: Indicates if the commercial is a transfer

priceTransfer.title: transfer price
priceTransfer.description: Only available if isAtransfer=true. Price of the transfer

transferEndContractDate.title: available from date
transferEndContractDate.description: Only available if operation=RENT, isAtransfer=true and priceTransfer filled. End date of the rental contract related to the commercial activity. The format must be 'yyyy-mm' (year-month)

hasDesk.title: has desk
hasDesk.description: Indicates if the room has desk

hasRoomAirConditioning.title: has room air conditioning
hasRoomAirConditioning.description: Indicates if the room has air conditioning

hasWashingMachine.title: has washing machine
hasWashingMachine.description: Indicates if the property has washing machine

residentOnly.title: resident only
residentOnly.description: Only allowed in some Italian areas, such as Trentino Alto Adige. Only allowed for residential and seasonal rental. Indicates if the property is only for residents

officeType.title: office type
officeType.description: office type based on space use. Coworking only available for rent operations. If coworking is submitted, the constructed area must be between 1 and 15 m2 with an openPlan layout.

sharedArea.title: shared area
sharedArea.description: Shared area square meters. Only allowed for office type coworking

additionalRentCharges.title: additional rent charges
additionalRentCharges.description: Only allowed if rentControl=true. Only for France with rent operation.

bareFree.title: bare free
bareFree.description: Only allowed in France when currentOccupation=life_estate.

baseRent.title: base rent
baseRent.description: Mandatory if rentControl=true. Only for France with rent operation.

bedroomNumber.title: bedroom number
bedroomNumber.description: Only allowed in France if studio!=true and rooms>1. Value must be lower than rooms

energyCertificationAdemeCode.title: energy certification ADEME code
energyCertificationAdemeCode.description: Only allowed in France. ADEME code of the energy certification.

energyCertificationDate.title: energy certification date
energyCertificationDate.description: Only allowed in France. Mandatory unless energyCertificateRating is exempt, unknown or in_process. Indicates if the DPE was issued before or after July 1st 2021

fee.title: agency fee
fee.description: Only allowed in France. Mandatory when feePayerType is 'buyer' or 'shared'. Agency fee amount.

feePayerType.title: fee payer type
feePayerType.description: Only allowed in France. Indicates who pays the agency fee. In case of operation rent only value allowed is 'seller'.

triplex.title: triplex
triplex.description: Only allowed in France. Property on three floors connected by an indoor staircase.

maxReferenceRent.title: max reference rent
maxReferenceRent.description: Mandatory if rentControl=true. Only for France with rent operation.

monthlyFee.title: monthly fee
monthlyFee.description: Only allowed in France when currentOccupation=life_estate.

rentControl.title: rent control
rentControl.description: Only allowed in France for rent operation. Indicates if the property is subject to rent control regulations.

serviceCharges.title: service charges
serviceCharges.description: Only allowed in France for rent operation. Monthly service charges amount.
